text:
Nadia (Product): Quick heads-up 11:00 UTC rollout1 1 audit-mode flag for Private/VPC agents. When enabled agents emit append-only access logs and produce signed audit bundles for each retention window. Intended for customers needing tamper-evident access records for audits.

Marco (Eng): Implementation notes: set agent.config.audit_mode=true and provide kms.key_id for signing. If kms.key_id absent, platform signing is used (customer opt-in recommended). Bundle endpoint: GET /agent/audit/bundles/<bundle_id> returns signed bundle (bundle_id, events[], sha256_manifest, signer_kid, ts). Example trigger: curl -X POST https://127.0.0.1:8443/agent/audit/rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'

Yvonne (SRE): Rollout plan: canary 8 sites 11:00-11:12 UTC, monitor bundle-gen-errors and local-disk-watermark. Alert if bundle-gen-error rate >0.5% over 5m or disk pressure >75%.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for private-audit-mode-v1 at 2026-05-10T11:00Z.

Nadia (Product): Action items: Legal - confirm audit wording; Support - KB steps + troubleshooting; Sales - 1-line blurb and CSM outreach list.

Priyanka (Legal): Quick check: signed bundle must include signer_kid, canonicalized event manifest, and a timestamp. Need short audit sentence: "Agent generates a signed, tamper-evident audit bundle containing tenant access events." I'll add contract language suggestions.

Al (Sales): Can we get a 20-30 word line we can use in customer notes? Also please share the canary customer list so CSMs can monitor.

Marco (Eng): Draft blurb: "Enable audit-mode on Private/VPC to generate tamper-evident, signed access bundles for compliance. Bundles include signer id and checksum for verification." Full FAQ to #docs after GA.

Yvonne (SRE): Canary metrics @11:08: 8 bundles generated, 0 bundle-gen-errors, median generation latency 60ms, disk usage stable. Proceeding to staged roll at 11:15.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Staged rollout initiated for private-audit-mode-v1 at 2026-05-10T11:16Z.

Tess (Support): I'll add KB titled "On-prem audit-mode: verify and collect bundles" with steps: call /agent/audit/bundles, validate signer_kid, check sha256_manifest, collect agent logs if mismatch. Will link when live.

Yvonne (SRE): Follow-ups: add Grafana panels for "bundle generation rate" and "bundle size distribution"; create alert for disk watermark; add runbook path: https://redir.company/runbooks/onprem-audit-mode.

Nadia (Product): Thanks all. GA announcement scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC pending Legal + Support links. If anything odd, @Nadia and tag #eng-oncall.

Al (Sales): Thanks 44d will prep customer outreach once KB + legal copy available.
